noun_definition: Android refers to the mobile operating system on which the app is running, which experiences a crash when the emoji picker is tapped after sending emoji art.
Chat refers to the messaging functionality within the app that allows users to send and receive messages, including emoji art.
Emoji art refers to images created using emojis that can be copied, pasted, and sent as messages within the chat application.
Emoji picker refers to the feature in the app that allows users to select and insert emojis into their messages, which is causing the app to crash when tapped after sending emoji art.
App refers to the mobile application being used to send messages and access the emoji picker feature in the context of the reported crash issue.
